industries.publicSpaces.description: Cleaning robots for waiting halls and terminals, wayfinding robots for service centers and museums, patrol robots. Night and off-peak cleaning. Site assessment.
industries.publicSpaces.name: Public venues and transport hubs
industries.publicSpaces.lead: Waiting halls and terminals run almost around the clock, and people arrive in waves, following train and flight schedules. Cleaning a huge floor area must not get in passengers’ way.
industries.publicSpaces.lead2: The robot washes floors at night and in lulls between peaks, while people handle restrooms, spot cleaning and visitors. Cleaning robots already work at six Russian Railways (RZD) stations.

industries.publicSpaces.heads.problems: Why halls are hard to keep clean.
industries.publicSpaces.problems.items.0: Waiting halls, terminals and concourses are huge, and people keep coming almost around the clock.
industries.publicSpaces.problems.items.1: Trains and flights bring people in waves. At the peak, a cleaner with a machine blocks passengers; after it, there’s the most dirt.
industries.publicSpaces.problems.items.2: Where the platforms are, which counter, how to reach the exhibition: staff spend the shift on routine answers.
industries.publicSpaces.staffing.text: of cleaning staff in Russia are foreign nationals. Regions are also tightening rules on hiring migrants: in 2025, 11 regions added restrictions.
industries.publicSpaces.flow.title: Between passenger waves.
industries.publicSpaces.flow.lead: People arrive in waves. The robot washes halls at night and in lulls between peaks: it doesn’t block passengers or drive over a wet floor in a crowd.
industries.publicSpaces.flow.chartDescri: Illustrative 24-hour passenger flow chart: a morning peak around 08:00, an evening peak around 18:00. Cleaning windows: 00:30–05:30 night washing; 10:30–12:30 after the morning wave; 14:00–15:45 midday lull; 21:15–23:45 after the evening wave.
industries.publicSpaces.flow.legend.note: Illustrative chart: the flow shape is an example. We record your site’s peak hours during the assessment and build the robot’s schedule around them.

industries.publicSpaces.directions.lead: Stations, airports, museums, exhibition centers, MFC public service centers and concert venues. Parks and streets are on the “Municipal services” page.
industries.publicSpaces.directions.items: Floor-scrubbing robots wash large areas at night and in the gaps between peaks. They build their own map of the hall and steer around people.
Service robots and humanoids in lobbies show the way, answer routine questions and greet exhibition guests.
A security robot patrols the perimeter, parking or empty halls at night along a set route and alerts the duty officer.
No Russian transport case studies yet
industries.publicSpaces.proof.title: Cleaning robots already work in stations and airports.
industries.publicSpaces.proof.lead: These are other companies’ deployments, not PROFROBOT projects. We show them to demonstrate that the equipment copes with halls and crowds.
industries.publicSpaces.proof.main.text: Autonomous cleaning robots sweep and wash halls, build their own map of the space and log the level of dirt. Productivity: up to 1,980 m² per hour. Russian Railways has not named the model or the number of robots.
industries.publicSpaces.proof.more.items: Cleaning robots with lidar and cameras in check-in and arrivals halls.
industries.publicSpaces.results.items.0: Halls are clean by the peak: cleaning runs at night and in lulls.
industries.publicSpaces.results.items.1: People move to restrooms, spot cleaning and working with visitors.
industries.publicSpaces.results.items.2: Less dependence on hiring in a labor-short cleaning market.
industries.publicSpaces.results.items.3: A cleaning map and zone reports show what was cleaned and when.
industries.publicSpaces.vendorsLead: We choose equipment by area, floor surface and site schedule, with no tie to a single vendor.
industries.publicSpaces.why.title: Traffic first, then the robot.
industries.publicSpaces.why.text: Before placing a robot, we study when and where people move and build the cleaning schedule around that. We source equipment from several manufacturers and service it under SLA across Russia.
